name: io.github.huynhtanan/google-hotels-mcp
title: Google Hotels MCP
description: Live Google Hotels and Google Vacation Rentals prices with per-OTA rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo, Airbnb) and a 3-month daily price calendar for any property, as JSON. Backed by three open-source Apify actors.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_TOKEN
